reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.reformed.0: Taxes in %s are lighter since so many left. Maybe we'll stay after all.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.reformed.1: The guards hardly stop anyone any more. %s's ruler finally noticed the empty houses.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.reformed.2: Folk were leaving %s by the cartload. Now things are easier, and the carts have stopped.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.stubborn.0: Half the street's packed up and gone, and %s's ruler won't change a thing.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.stubborn.1: If things don't get better in %s, I'll be loading a cart myself, %s.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.stubborn.2: Every week another family leaves %s. Soon there'll be no one left to rule.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.reformed.3: They say %s is welcoming settlers now. Lighter taxes, fewer tolls. Folk are moving in.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.tolerance.0: There's a decree in %s now: no jeering at folk for their blood. Some still mutter, but quieter.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.tolerance.1: Since the edict in %s, my Tideborn neighbour finally walks to market without the stares.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.tolerance.2: Took half the non-humans leaving %s for the ruler to put a stop to the mockery.
